turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Was Owen heard before you entered that zero?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
I didn't. Was he heard first, yes or no?
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
It says I haven't gone yet. What do you have besides a checker?
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
No. A deal for what? Show me what you have on his essay.
